notes: First lore form episode. Maya and Raj lead end-to-end. Specimen vignette (~5 lines) opens with both forms of the root (வேணும் / வேண்டாம்) back-to-back; lore discussion covers: literary->spoken compression (வேண்டும்->வேணும்), Tamil's refusal to split want/need, Sangam-era root, negation mirror வேண்டாம், and the 'வேணும் வேண்டாம்' mixed-feelings reading. Turn: the grandmother's moral-command use of வேணும் flips the frame — same word as the tea order, categorically different weight.
